newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on April 25:
WASHINGTON - The Justice Department gave its approval to Bell Atlantic Corp.'s proposed $20-billion-acquisition of regional telephone company Nynex Corp.

WASHINGTON - The U.S. economy is humming along with strong growth, low unemployment, low inflation, rising wages, high profits and a bullish stock market. And there is sharp disagreement over how to keep it that way.

WASHINGTON - President Clinton has sent a blunt letter to Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto warning that Tokyo's economic policies raise the risk of a dangerous surge in Japan's trade surplus.

WASHINGTON - Comsat Corp. sued its former chief executive, Bruce Crockett, alleging he violated a resignation agreement by engaging in a "conspiracy" with two shareholders to unseat members of the company's board of directors.
